question_text: A manufacturer of pet foods was wondering whether cat owners and dog owners reacted differently to premium pet foods. Is it reasonable to conclude, at alpha = 0.02, that cat owners are more likely than dog owners to feed their pets premium food? What proportion of cat owners used premium food for their cats?

options.text: Reject H0, and conclude that the advertising campaign has been effective
Accept H0, and conclude that the advertising campaign has not been effective
Reject H0, and conclude that the advertising campaign has not been effective
Accept H0, and conclude that the advertising campaign has been effective
